lessons.name: flaky_ci_async_cleanup
lessons.description: Flaky CI test from unawaited async cleanup
lessons.applies_when: A test using an async HTTP client fixture fails intermittently in CI (not locally) with 'Event loop is closed' or a dangling-task warning during teardown.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to purely synchronous tests, or to fixtures whose client library already blocks until shutdown in its own `__aexit__`.

lessons.name: n_plus_one_api_timeout
lessons.description: N+1 query timeout on list endpoint
lessons.applies_when: A list endpoint's p99 latency jumped after a related field (e.g. author, owner) was added to each row of the response, and DB query logs show one extra query fired per row instead of one batched query.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to single-item (detail) endpoints, where one extra query per request is not per-row and is usually fine.

lessons.name: pagination_off_by_one
lessons.description: Off-by-one pagination bug dropping or duplicating the boundary row
lessons.applies_when: Clients report a record missing or duplicated when paging through a list; usually happens right at the page boundary and only for certain page sizes.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to offset-based (LIMIT/OFFSET) pagination, whose failure mode is different (concurrent inserts shifting offsets).

lessons.name: batch_job_fd_leak
lessons.description: Batch job memory/file-descriptor leak from unclosed handles
lessons.applies_when: A batch/import job that processes many files grows in memory and eventually OOMs or hits the OS file-descriptor limit partway through a run that used to complete fine on smaller inputs.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to a single resource opened once outside the loop and reused across items.

lessons.name: cache_invalidation_race
lessons.description: Stale cache read from a race between write and invalidation
lessons.applies_when: Immediately after a record is updated, a concurrent read sometimes repopulates the cache with the pre-update value, so the next several reads serve stale data until the TTL expires.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to cache-aside reads with a short TTL and no correctness requirement on immediate consistency.

lessons.name: timezone_date_filter_bug
lessons.description: Timezone-naive date filter drops records near midnight UTC
lessons.applies_when: A 'records for date X' filter misses or includes records near midnight depending on the user's timezone, because the filter compares a naive calendar date against a timestamp column stored in UTC.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to filters that are already explicitly documented and tested as UTC-calendar-day semantics.
